# The Traveler

> > Real-world travel guides, booking tutorials, and destination stories covering Europe, North America, and beyond—from GetYourGuide tips to AAA TripTik planning.

The Traveler is an independent publication featuring practical travel advice, step-by-step booking guides for platforms like GetYourGuide, Costco Travel, and Tiqets, plus cultural destination stories from contributors Alex Cornici and Liga Rudzite. Content spans budget travel strategies, EU visa regulations, and destination-specific guides across Italy, France, Greece, Canada, and the United States.

- [AAA Travel Explained: Membership, Key Benefits, and How It All Works](https://thetraveler.org/aaa-travel-explained-membership-key-benefits-and-how-it-all-works): AAA Classic, Plus, Premier: roadside assistance & travel benefits compared

- [Explore France on a Budget](https://thetraveler.org/explore-france-on-a-budget): Budget France travel: cheap trains, hostels, Paris to Provence on less
